facts.fact: 纽约飞奥斯汀四个半小时，Everett 想办法弄到头等舱座位。
facts.anchor: It takes four and a half hours to fly from New York to Austin. Four and a half long, restless hours.

facts.fact: Everett 早上发短信说自己忙、可能要派别人接机。
facts.anchor: Everett texted me this morning to say he’s busy and might have to send someone else to pick me up.

facts.fact: 她昨天压力性烤出的饼干和布朗尼塞爆背包，只好托运行李箱。
facts.anchor: But it turns out that all of the cookies and brownies I stress-baked yesterday take up more space in my backpack than I anticipated

facts.fact: Everett 亲自到机场接机，兄妹拥抱。
facts.anchor: My brother’s arms close around me and I’m home, at last. I breathe in his familiar scent—leather and dirt, and something unique—and relax in his embrace.

facts.fact: 进家门后妈妈先含泪拥抱，爸爸把她抱起转圈。
facts.anchor: Dad is next, lifting me clean off my feet and spinning me in a circle.

facts.fact: Harriet 的孕肚一周里明显变大。
facts.anchor: The last text I got from her showed a still mostly-flat stomach, but in the last week, that baby has grown.

facts.fact: Emmy Jean 现在两岁半，圣诞节后出生，年底满三岁。
facts.anchor: She must be two and a half now. She was born right after Christmas, and she’ll turn three at the end of this year.

facts.fact: Brooks 贴到她背后翻找饼干，嗓音比记忆中低沉温暖。
facts.anchor: Brooks is right behind me, chest almost pressed against my back, and his voice is even deeper and warmer than I remember.

relations: Harriet–Brooks：亲姐姐；对 Ashton 是血亲之外的姐姐，怀孕中，带女儿 Emmy Jean
